title: Kim Yoo-jung and Park Jin-young shed the "100 Days of Lies"… Confronting the hidden truth

 From left, Kim Yoo-jung and Park Jin-young /Photo=tvN "100 Days of Lies" /Photo=tvN "100 Days of Lies" In "100 Days of Lies," Kim Yoo-jung and Park Jin-young shed their lies and face each other.
 The production team of tvN's 20th-anniversary special project weekend drama "100 Days of Lies" (directed by Yoo In-sik and Kim Yun-jin) released stills on the 14th, ahead of the broadcast of Episode 11, showing Lee Ga-kyung (played by Kim Yoo-jung) and Kim Tae-woong (played by Park Jin-young) unexpectedly encountering each other in Ttokmak Village. The images foreshadow the crisis of their identities being exposed, which can no longer be avoided, as well as another incident that will shake up Ttokmak Village.
 In the previous episode, tension rose when a time bomb planted by the National Salvation Corps exploded during the commemorative banquet for the opening of the Joseon Governor-General's Office postal route. That night, searches and inspections began for suspects in the bombing, and Kim Tae-woong and police officers stormed into Heewon. At the moment the investigation focused on Yoo So-ran (played by Kim Hyun-joo), Lee Ga-kyung appeared, barely averting the crisis. Since that day, the relationship between Lee Ga-kyung and Kim Tae-woong has entered a new phase. Kim Tae-woong, who had grown suspicious of Lee Ga-kyung's movements, began to suspect him of being a spy. His secretive and sharp interrogation, "You're a spy, aren't you?", raised heart rates.
 Amidst this, the released stills draw attention as a suspicious(?) woman appears in the once peaceful Ttokmak Village. The person revealed from behind a tightly wrapped scarf, as if no one would see, is none other than Lee Ga-kyung. Both Inoma (played by Hong Sa-bin) and Bang Kkot-nim (played by Kim Ra-hee), who had believed Lee Ga-kyung had left for the United States, are beaming with bright smiles at their reunion after a long time.
 However, the joyful reunion of the three is short-lived as an unexpected visit from Kim Tae-woong brings a precarious moment. The cat-and-mouse-like moment between Lee Ga-kyung, who hurriedly turns his face away, and Kim Tae-woong, who senses something suspicious, piques interest. Eventually, noticed by a resident of Ttokmak Village, Lee Ga-kyung is left in an awkward position, fumbling with an embarrassed smile. Curiosity is focused on whether all of his secrets, including his true name and origin, will be revealed following the exposure of his identity as a spy.
 Another photo released together captures a mysterious uninvited guest, adding to the intrigue. In the midst of a commotion that drew Ttokmak Village residents one by one, Kim Tae-woong is seen grabbing and subduing a stranger's wrist with an angry face. Above all, Lee Ga-kyung, who watched this unfold, shows a mix of shock and bewilderment on his face, and an unusual atmosphere is felt among the Ttokmak Village residents as well. Attention is focused on the identity of the uninvited guest that shook up Ttokmak Village and what incident will occur in the meeting between Lee Ga-kyung and Kim Tae-woong.
 Additionally, Episode 11 depicts Lee Ga-kyung and Kim Tae-woong, who cannot deny their feelings for each other despite deepening confusion. As a previous teaser revealed a scene where Kim Tae-woong says, "It is nice to meet you, Ms. Lee Ga-kyung," calling her "Lee Ga-kyung" instead of "Geum Seo-hee," anticipation grows for the changes that will come to their relationship.
 The production team of "100 Days of Lies" stated, "Lee Ga-kyung and Kim Tae-woong face a hidden truth and are engulfed in complex emotions. The story of the two, who now want to erase lies and suspicion and trust each other, or hope to be trusted, will offer a tender excitement."
 Episode 11 of "100 Days of Lies" airs at 9:10 p.m. on the 14th.
